title: Fur Friends ⚔️ Battle Edition Day 30 | The Grand Raid | Cozy Kawaii RPG Animation & Lofi
description:
All 20 friends gather for the Grand Raid! Together they face the Sleepy Sky Dragon on top of Dragon Peak... who turns out to just need a friend. A big celebration closes the first season of Fur Friends: Battle Edition.

0:00 Gathering the Party
0:45 Dragon Peak
1:30 The Sky Dragon
2:15 The Grand Celebration

⚔️ Fur Friends: Battle Edition — the Fur Friends are adventuring in Pawlandia Online, a cozy fantasy MMORPG world. A new friend joins every episode!
🐾 No one gets hurt: bonked monsters just get dizzy, then become friends.
🎧 Best with headphones. Original lofi music & cozy fantasy sounds.
